culprit_citations.quoted_text: Portfolio Company column is blank on a continuation row for Ambient Photonics, Inc.; separate cells show Type of Investment Secured Loan, Investment Date December 20, 2022, Maturity Date June 1, 2025, Interest Rate Variable interest rate Prime + 6.0 % or Floor rate 9.5 %; EOT 4.0 %, Cost 324, Fair Value 305.

findings.detail: Issuer-name extraction concatenated schedule headers/category and investment terms into issuer_name instead of carrying forward the portfolio company name Ambient Photonics, Inc.

rationale: The source schedule has a Portfolio Company column separate from Type of Investment, Investment Date, Maturity Date, and Interest Rate. In table 15, Ambient Photonics, Inc. appears as the portfolio company on row 5 and rows 6-7 are continuation rows for the same issuer, while row 7 separately contains Secured Loan, December 20, 2022, June 1, 2025, and the interest-rate terms. The stored issuer_name concatenates the section/category and all of those terms, so the fmt_issuer_name flag is a real extraction defect.
